youtube_metadata.title: Frontier AI Safety Pact: OpenAI, Anthropic & Google Form SAFA #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and Microsoft have formed the Standards Authority for Frontier AI (SAFA), establishing mandatory red-team testing thresholds and real-time vulnerability sharing before model releases.
